Orrery Data code and source attribution

The fixed-width field mapping, Julian-day conversion and discovery selection
semantics derive from data/data_to_json.py in sn3p/Orrery, revision
1968ca40f02b36a7190153ebcda4c706c30e0e7b:
https://github.com/sn3p/Orrery/blob/1968ca40f02b36a7190153ebcda4c706c30e0e7b/data/data_to_json.py

Upstream data is provided by the International Astronomical Union Minor
Planet Center (MPC), with the work of astrometric observers and orbit
computers acknowledged. The software MIT license does not relicense MPC data.
Redistribute this notice and MPCORB-header.txt alongside derived catalogs.
The master retains the per-orbit reference and computer credits; the compact
consumer catalog intentionally omits those fields. Keep the corresponding
master, header and manifest available when distributing a consumer profile.

Up-to-date source files and documentation:
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/MPCORB/MPCORB.DAT.gz
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/lists/NumberedMPs.txt
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/MPCORB.html
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/info/MPOrbitFormat.html
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/info/PackedDes.html
https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/lists/NumberedMPs.html

Orbital elements are heliocentric, with J2000 ecliptic angles and TT epochs.
Fixed-element propagation is approximate, not a precision ephemeris service.
